summary.text: Steven Smith is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He defeated incumbent Bill Bell in the May 12, 2026 Republican primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a farmer and retired fund administrator.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Smith said he is a certified public accountant with a bachelor's degree in accounting from West Virginia University and an MBA from West Virginia Wesleyan.
He listed past positions including chairman, president and chief executive of Ameribank in Charleston and chief financial officer of Heritage Bancorp.
He said he chairs the Doddridge County Board of Health and serves on the West Virginia Investment Management Board.
Smith listed his campaign messages as support for working families and economic development, opposition to abortion, and support for the Second Amendment.
